summary.text: Tony Sorrentino is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 39, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Tony Sorrentino's occupation as an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Tony Sorrentino was born on July 26, 1954, in Omaha.

Tony Sorrentino graduated from Archbishop Rummel High School in 1972, earned a B.S. in business administration from Creighton University in 1976, and earned a J.D. from Creighton University School of Law in 1981.
Tony Sorrentino was practice leader at the Silverstone Group.
Tony Sorrentino has served on the board of trustees of Doane University since 2016.
Tony Sorrentino married Catherine Jean Rollman on June 27, 1981, and they have four children.
